title: Stale Instruction Files Override the Code in Coding Agents: A One-Sentence Fix
abstract: arXiv:2610.30571v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Purpose: Coding agents follow a project's instruction file, such as CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, even when it disagrees with the existing code and even when they notice the disagreement. We measure this behaviour and test whether one sentence in the user's own instruction file makes agents follow the code instead.   Methods: We built 40 Python projects in which the instruction file asks for one convention while the existing code uses another, for example print instead of logging. Claude Code and Codex CLI added a feature to each project, with and without a sentence in the user-level instruction file that gives the existing code precedence, in 320 runs.   Results: Without the sentence, 90.1% of the agents' choices followed the stale file. Claude Code pointed out the conflict in 79 of 80 runs and still followed the file. Codex CLI rewrote the existing code to match the file in 20 of 80 runs, and the project's own tests then failed in 17 of them

translated_title: 过时的指令文件凌驾于编码智能体中的代码之上：一句话修复方案
translated_abstract: 目的：编码智能体会遵循项目的指令文件（如 CLAUDE.md 或 AGENTS.md），即使该文件与现有代码不一致，甚至当它们察觉到这种不一致时也是如此。我们测量了这种行为，并测试在用户自己的指令文件中加入一句话能否让智能体转而遵循代码。方法：我们构建了40个Python项目，其中指令文件要求一种规范，而现有代码使用另一种规范（例如使用print而非日志记录）。Claude Code 和 Codex CLI 在每个项目中添加一个功能，共进行320次运行，分别测试用户级指令文件中包含和不包含“现有代码优先”这句话的情况。结果：在没有这句话的情况下，90.1%的智能体选择遵循过时的文件。Claude Code 在80次运行中有79次指出了冲突，但仍然遵循该文件。Codex CLI 在80次运行中有20次重写了现有代码以匹配指令文件，其中有17次导致项目自身的测试失败。
tldr: 研究发现编码智能体（如Claude Code和Codex CLI）会盲目遵循过时的项目指令文件而忽视实际代码，甚至在察觉到冲突并指出来时仍然如此，而只需在用户指令文件中加入一句“现有代码优先”即可有效修复这一问题。
en_tdlr: Coding agents like Claude Code and Codex CLI blindly follow stale instruction files over actual code even when they notice and report the conflict, but this can be fixed by adding a single sentence to the user's instruction file giving existing code precedence.
